S.FORM: alang Paumeli ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Kingbong go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 80 buwan, 270 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 260 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 10 hi nya. rhzyal kki'an lingay na Paumeli ga Kalatadrang ru Viljauljaul. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Paumeli ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Paumeli ga ungat pqwasan biru. khu skwan biru qalang Paumeli ga maki 1 khu skwan biru tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ paumeli ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu kiŋβoŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja rħzjal kkiʔan liŋaj na paumeli ɣa kalata*raŋ ru *iljauljaul reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ paumeli ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ paumeli ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru kħu [s|ɕ]kwan βiru qalaŋ paumeli ɣa maki * kħu [s|ɕ]kwan βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
